summary: preinstall hook sideloads an undeclared sibling package into the parent directory
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script `cd.. && npm i randompkgb` that runs automatically on `npm install`. The hook installs a separate npm package (randompkgb) into the installer's parent directory rather than declaring it as a normal dependency, bypassing the installer's lockfile, dependency audit, and resolution controls. The tarball ships no other functional code (no index.js or library entry), so the sole effect of installing this package is to fetch and execute whatever randompkgb currently contains at install time. Because randompkgb is resolved unpinned at install time, its author can swap the payload by publishing a new version of randompkgb without any change to this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
